prompt: A clock hand points at the 12. It sweeps around to the 3. That is a QUARTER of a full turn. How many degrees did it turn?
hint: A full turn all the way around is $360^\circ$.

hints.text: A full turn all the way around is $360^\circ$.
A quarter of a full turn is $360 \div 4$.

explanation: One trip all the way around a circle is $360^\circ$.
Twelve to three is one quarter of the way around the clock face.
$360 \div 4 = 90$, so the hand swept $90^\circ$ — a right angle.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count the hour marks
steps: The clock face has 12 hour marks, and the whole face is 360°.
So each hour mark is 360 ÷ 12 = 30°. From 12 to 3 is 3 marks: 3 × 30 = 90°.

alternativeExplanations.title: Fold the circle in half, then half again
steps: Half a turn is 180° — that would land the hand on the 6.
Half of THAT is 90°, which lands on the 3. So a quarter turn is 90°.
